description:
Get the calling API key's own redacted metadata (id, name, key_prefix, environment, scopes, last_used_at, revoked_at, created_at) for agent self-inspection. Never returns the key hash or full secret. Requires API-key auth — a JWT session has no single-key context (returns 400 api_key_required).

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Set PROOF_API_KEY and restart this server, then call this tool again. start_login does NOT open this tool.
name: get_self_api_key

outputSchema.description: An API key's redacted metadata, as the calling key reads itself (`GET /me/api-key`). Never carries the key value.

expires_at.description: When the key stops authenticating; null means it never expires. Enforced at authentication — an expired key is rejected exactly like an unknown one.

last_used_at.description: When the key last authenticated a request; null if never

profile_id.description: Sub-account (PublicProfile) the key is bound to; null for unbound keys.

replaced_key_ids.description: Ids of the keys this key replaced, newest first: the earlier keys of the same integration, replaced when the key was regenerated (`POST /api/v1/me/api-keys/{id}/regenerate`) or renewed by an MCP sign-in refresh. Requests and usage of those keys count as this key's. Empty when it replaced none. Recorded from the release of key history on; a key replaced before it is not linked.

revoked_at.description: When the key was revoked; null while it is live
